description: For the person's own confirmed appointment with more than one signer: returns a short note they can send to the other signer themselves, with the time, the ID to bring, not to sign beforehand and, for an online session, the camera test link. Nothing is sent by this tool, and the note leaves out the private booking link, the address and the booking number on purpose. Needs the person's private booking link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= value from that link

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…). Or give ref and token separately.

ref.description: Instead of link: the booking number, e.g. MCC-AB12CD

name: signer_note
title: A note for the other signer
